chunks: And why should we not believe in God and what has come down to us of the truth? And we hope to be admitted by our Lord among those who are upright and do good?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'And why should we not believe in God' in Surah Al-Ma'idah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate the high spiritual status of the disciples (Hawariyyun) as witnesses to the truth, linking their faith to the concept of *Tawhid* and the acceptance of divine messengers. It underscores the communal aspect of salvation, where individual piety is validated by inclusion among the *Salihin* (righteous), a group frequently associated with the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia tradition. The verse serves as a model for believers to emulate in their sincere hope for divine mercy and entry into Paradise.
